## Research interests

Synthetic aperture radar · complex-valued / phase-aware deep learning ·
geospatial foundation models · remote sensing for environmental and humanitarian use.

## Education

- **Ph.D., Electrical Engineering** — The University of Texas at Dallas, 2022.
  GPA 4.0/4.0. Advisor: Prof. Murat Torlak. Dissertation: *Novel Hybrid-Learning
  Algorithms for Improved Millimeter-Wave Imaging Systems*. Five first-author IEEE
  papers; one granted patent.
- **B.S., Electrical Engineering** — The University of Texas at Dallas, 2019.
  GPA 3.98/4.0, *summa cum laude*; completed in three years. 2× UTDesign Senior
  Capstone 1st place.

## Experience

### Geospatial AI — Privateer Space
*Jan 2025 – Present*

- Architected and shipped a multi-tenant no-code geospatial CV/MLOps platform that takes
  non-experts from idea to deployed model — automating planetary-scale preprocessing,
  foundation-model fine-tuning, and one-click cloud/edge deployment.
- Built and owned the model fine-tuning, inference, and deployment orchestration backbone,
  plus end-to-end production health (logs, metrics, alerts) across ingest, training, and
  inference services.
- Drove adoption of agentic engineering workflows, shipping production code across multiple
  codebases.

### Principal Research Scientist — KBR
*Sep 2023 – Jan 2025*

- Led production SAR pipelines for dark-vessel detection and refocusing of underway ships
  at high resolution — joint time-frequency deep-learning tooling for ML on SAR SLC and
  phase-history products at scale, improving dark-vessel detection **2×**.
- Trained custom SAR foundation models and fine-tuned pretrained geospatial foundation
  models on SAR data for ship feature extraction, moving-object refocusing, and
  multi-sensor detection.
- Accelerated production model training and inference with a dependency-free C/C++ ML
  library, a custom SAR ray-tracing engine for synthetic moving-ship data generation
  (**400×** speedup), and a SAR image-formation pipeline cutting wall-clock **1000×**.

### Postdoctoral Research Associate — The University of Texas at Dallas
*Jan 2023 – Sep 2023*

- Researched, published, and patented novel domain-informed machine-learning
  architectures yielding faster-converging, performant, and generalizable models for RF
  image and signal processing.
- Authored a novel hybrid deep-learning / signal-processing framework for SAR multiband
  fusion achieving nearly **3×** super-resolution on a prototype, reducing cost **10–20×**.
- Developed complex-valued neural network (CVNN) solutions for frequency estimation,
  improving probability of resolution by ~**10%** in degraded scenarios and up to **15%**
  in low-SNR scenarios.
- Published a smartphone-based SAR algorithm for concealed-object detection via a novel
  imaging approach that reduced computation time **50,000×**, enabling real-time image
  formation.

### Wireless Sensing Technologist (Research) — Microsoft
*Sep 2022 – Jan 2023*

- Built and shipped ML infrastructure, influencing cross-functional teams of architects
  and scientists to advance AI sensing modalities and accelerating delivery timelines for
  novel wireless-sensing products.
- Pioneered multimodal sensor fusion (RF, mmWave, ToF, LiDAR) for advanced modeling and
  full-body pose estimation, optimizing algorithms for performance-constrained environments.
- Contributed to the broader AI research community — authoring multiple publications and
  filing patents on novel sensing and tracking architectures within the first six months.

### Display Calibration AI/ML Intern — Apple
*2021*

- Proposed and patented power-mitigation strategies enhancing display performance (**1.5×**
  gain) while optimizing power and heat constraints through model-based techniques (shipped
  in 2025 iPhone).
- Developed holistic display-calibration techniques from register-level interface to
  model-based gradient descent for **2×** calibration-time reduction on future display
  technologies.
- Deployed an automated ML solution that reduced production-line display-calibration time
  **5×**.

### Computational Imaging & Deep Learning Research Intern — IMEC
*2020*

- Created and published a state-of-the-art wireless 3-D hand-tracking input prototype
  fusing signal processing and deep learning, outperforming prior SOTA localization **7×**.
- Developed the first real-time data-streaming interface for automotive radars via
  UDP-layer communications in C/C++ with a shared-memory MATLAB interface.

### mmWave Radar Perception Intern — Texas Instruments (TxACE)
*2019*

- Researched mmWave radar perception and RF AI/ML for automotive and gesture-sensing
  applications.
